teaser: Four missed calls sit unanswered on the counter before you think to glance at the phone. Life path 4 built you for steady walls and finished work; ESTP built you for the next open door. The two sit oddly in one chest: the Builder wants the wall load-bearing and permanent, the Persuader wants to test it by kicking it first. What is particular here is speed married to patience — brick laid fast, then a wait for the mortar to cure. The foundation under you gets built between other things, and still manages to hold.
excerpt: Folding the parent-teacher handout into quarters while still listening, you nod at the schedule change before your partner finishes proposing it.
